description: UK homes for sale in London (first results page, up to 25) from the public rightmove.co.uk search page: address, asking price in GBP, bedrooms, bathrooms, size and summary. Read from the page's embedded JSON; Rightmove has no free public read API. Related tools on this server, for a different need: realestate_auction_com_property when you need HUD homes for sale by online bid in a US state or city; realestate_purplebricks_property when you need recorded UK residential sale prices and dates for one. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
